what_happened: PR #294 asked for an exact-head review of the Volc signer repair but carried 55 files, including video-output binaries, job logs, relay copies and a 2046-line funded-order inspection record.
expected: A PR sent for exact-head review contains only the files the review covers.

root_cause.text: Merging main into the working branch brought unrelated files into the PR diff.

rule: Before requesting an exact-head review, compare the PR file list with the review scope and open a clean PR when they differ.
